markets.label: United States

facts.statement: Employer match is optional; check the cap and vesting schedule. Contributions are tax-advantaged.
W-2 employees have tax withheld and may get benefits; 1099 contractors generally do not.
Work authorization is status-specific; H-1B sponsorship is a hard gate, and cap-subject cases go through a lottery.

markets.note: Federal baseline; state law varies. Information only, not legal advice.

markets.label: United Kingdom

facts.statement: 5.6 weeks paid holiday a year (28 days for a 5-day week). Bank holidays can be included; the statutory cap is 28 days.
Automatic enrolment minimum: 3% employer + 5% employee = 8% of qualifying earnings. Many employers pay more.
Employers must check right to work before employment. Sponsoring a visa requires a licensed sponsor.
Probation is contractual, not a single statutory length; notice during probation can be shorter. Notice is set by the contract plus a statutory floor.
Off-payroll working rules apply to contractors. Inside IR35 is taxed like employment; outside is not. Status is fact-specific.

markets.note: UK-wide baseline; Scotland and Northern Ireland can differ. Information only, not legal advice.

markets.label: Germany

facts.statement: Statutory minimum is 24 working days a year, which is 20 days for a 5-day week. Contracts or Tarifverträge often give more.
Statutory notice is 4 weeks to the end of a month; tenure or contract can extend it, and probation notice can be shorter.
The Blue Card requires a recognised qualification and a salary above the annual threshold; the employer usually drives the application.

source.label: Make it in Germany · Blue Card

markets.note: German baseline; Tarifverträge and contracts can differ. Information only, not legal advice.

markets.label: France

facts.statement: 5 weeks (30 working days) paid leave per year is the baseline; RTT days can add more for roles above 35 hours.
Trial length depends on contract and status (CDI/CDD); notice during the trial is shorter.
Employers must cover at least 50% of the health insurance (mutuelle) premium.

markets.note: French baseline; convention collective and contract can differ. Information only, not legal advice.

markets.label: Netherlands

facts.statement: Statutory minimum is 4 weeks (20 days) holiday plus 8% vakantiegeld on gross annual salary.
Max 2 months for permanent contracts, 1 month for 6–24 months, and none for contracts under 6 months.
Expat tax benefit; eligibility and rate change over time. Confirm with the employer before relying on it.

markets.note: Dutch baseline; CAO and contract can differ. Information only, not legal advice.
